cell_note: Normalized verdict records: decisions, verdicts, booleans, rule names, hashes, counts. Tool output, model text, transcripts, fixture contents, session ids, and absolute local paths are NOT embedded. Each cell carries source_sha256 of the original record bytes so a holder of the original can confirm the match.
caveats: No sandbox anywhere (Docker absent -- not-started, never a pass); container runs as root.
Cheaper arm used beam-free $0 tier via localhost proxy; proxy rewrites model, agents hold dummy-local-only.
Meta arm model muse-spark-1.1 is the oldest verified-working model (an assumption, stated as such).
Drivers answer DENY to every approval dialog (fail-closed).
V1-23 cells are the POST-REPAIR runs (2026-11-03 repair pass).
Main's published tallies.json is NOT updated by the local repair pass; this bundle's target is the LOCAL corrected tallies.json.
exclusions: Exactly one stray: strands/cheaper/r7/V1-13/record.json (FAIL-INCOMPLETE outside the matrix; changes no tally).
Agent final text / transcripts (hermes) -- model text, not verdict evidence.
Logs (3.7 GB local tree) -- records only.
provenance: Local ~/workspace/live-agents-v1/runs/ (480 records: 5 agents x 2 arms x 2 repeats x 24 scenarios). Published package on main: framework/scorecard/live-agents-v1/ (SUMMARY + runners + tallies, pre-repair tallies).
